description: Reads one source inspection by session_id and probe_id, waiting up to wait_seconds (default $MAX_WAIT_SECONDS) for a queued inspection to settle. Returns bounded evidence with status queued, complete, truncated or failed. A worker can take a few minutes to start, so while it is queued, call again with the same ids without asking the person; an inspection that will never run reads as failed. After about 10 minutes still queued, stop and tell the person it never started. A missing legacy endpoint is reported as capability unavailable and is not emulated.
name: get_source_inspection
title: Read source inspection status
